frozen_note: Set frozen to true, with the date, only after supervisor agreement and the pilot. The main stage refuses to run while frozen is false.

melodies.bach_sample_rule: 40 eligible, non-duplicate Bach chorale sopranos from the music21 corpus that both models accept, drawn with bach_sample_seed; Strube states that his chorale exercises are Bach melodies (1928, p. 174), so no exercise is typed

deepbach.source_of_defaults: deepBach.py (num_iterations 500, model sizes) and DeepBach/model_manager.py generation() (temperature 1.0, batch_size_per_voice 8), commit 6d75cb9

analysis.q1: descriptive: each model and Bach's own harmonization of the same melodies, model minus Bach per melody, copy_share
analysis.q2_test: Wilcoxon signed-rank, DeepBach minus Coconet per melody, two-sided, zero_method wilcox, method auto
analysis.zone_definition: F: a motion whose start or arrival step lies inside a soprano note carrying a fermata (parallel fifths, parallel octaves, overlap), or an event inside such a note (spacing, crossing); I: everything else. Flags and opportunities are instrument 2.0 main counts (research/phrase_zones.py)
analysis.zone_test: q3: Wilcoxon signed-rank per model on fermata-zone rate minus inside-phrase rate per melody; each rate is flags divided by opportunities, both summed over the melody's valid generations; two-sided, zero_method wilcox, method auto; melodies without opportunities in a zone are left out of that rule
analysis.effect_sizes: matched-pairs rank-biserial; positive means DeepBach higher (q2) or the fermata zone higher (q3)
analysis.secondary: weighted penalty index for q2, tested outside the Holm family
analysis.bach_zone_pattern: descriptive: the same zone rates on Bach's own harmonizations of the sampled melodies
sensitivity: a: q2 with motions starting while the soprano holds a fermata note excluded
b: DeepBach seen versus unseen Bach melodies, only if the training membership is verified
c: q2 and q3 on melodies whose five generations all pass quality control for both models
d: q2 and q3 with repeated equal pitches merged in every voice before measuring
analysis.optional_extension: DeepBach with its fermata metadata removed, on the same melodies, as a manipulated variable; not part of 3.0 unless the supervisors ask for it
